backend/main.mo: Primary backend actor implementing taxi pickup logging, user profiles, customers, reporting, and access control using ordered maps and blob storage mixin.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to impacted frontend files, components, and test requirements.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing roles of various frontend files, mainly UI components, hooks, and styling adjustments.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML file bootstrapping the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app entry handling identity, actor initialization, profile setup flow, and global theming.
frontend/src/components/AboutDialog.tsx: Dialog component displaying app information, copyright text, and contact details.
frontend/src/components/ActorInitializat: Gate component controlling backend actor initialization with loading, error diagnostics, retry, logout, and hard refresh options.
frontend/src/components/CustomerLookup.t: Provides a searchable popover for selecting or clearing customers using suggestions from a query hook.
frontend/src/components/CycleBalanceDial: Displays the current cycle balance with a refresh option and formatted output in a dialog.
frontend/src/components/DailyReportDialo: Shows daily totals for a selected date range with calendar pickers and a scrollable results area.
frontend/src/components/DeleteAllRecords: Dialog that confirms and triggers deletion of all records, showing loading states and readiness checks.
frontend/src/components/DeleteDraftDataD: Empty file with no implemented content.
frontend/src/components/EditDeleteRecord: Allows selecting, editing, or deleting recent pickup records with form handling and mutation calls.
frontend/src/components/EditProfileDialo: Form dialog for viewing and updating driver profile details with validation and save handling.
frontend/src/components/ExportImportDial: Modal allowing users to export app data to a JSON file and import data from a selected JSON file.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Simple footer displaying copyright text and a link to caffeine.ai.
frontend/src/components/GeneratePDFDialo: Dialog that generates and downloads a static HTML-based PDF specification document.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Main header with navigation menus, theme toggle, user actions, and launchers for various dialogs.
frontend/src/components/PickupForm.tsx: Form for recording a new taxi pickup, including customer info, payment details, and date/time handling.
frontend/src/components/PickupList.tsx: Lists pickups for a selected date, calculates totals, and formats pickup data for display.
frontend/src/docs/manual-qa-android-chro: Checklist for verifying opacity and backdrop behavior of overlays, popovers, selects, and dialogs in Android Chrome.
frontend/src/docs/manual-qa-edit-delete-: Checklist for testing scrolling, background scroll lock, and overlay stacking in the Edit/Delete Record dialog on Android Chrome.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and caches a backend actor, reinitializing when identity changes and invalidating dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useActorReady.ts: Wrapper hook exposing actor readiness and loading/error states from useBackendActor.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdmin.tsx: Empty placeholder file with no implemented logic.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackendActor.tsx: Context provider managing backend actor initialization with retries, health checks, identity handling, and readiness state.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity context, handling login, stored identity loading, and identity lifecycle management.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for profile, pickups, customer suggestions, and other backend data using actor readiness.
frontend/src/hooks/useRadixOverlayCleanu: Hook that removes stale scroll-lock styles when no Radix dialogs are open to prevent frozen scrolling on Android Chrome.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers, light/dark theme color variables, and global Radix UI z-index and opacity fixes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AccountSetupPage.tsx: Provides a form for drivers to set up or edit their profile with validation and mutation handling.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: Empty placeholder file for the admin dashboard page.
frontend/src/pages/AdminLoginPage.tsx: Empty placeholder file for the admin login page.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Renders the login screen with Internet Identity authentication and theme toggle.
frontend/src/pages/LoginSelectionPage.ts: Empty placeholder file for a login selection page.
frontend/src/pages/MainApp.tsx: Main app layout showing header, pickup form, and daily pickup list.
frontend/src/utils/connectionDiagnostics: Provides functions to normalize initialization errors and generate diagnostic messages.
frontend/src/utils/errorMessage.ts: Extracts a stable message string from various error shapes.
frontend/src/utils/numberFormat.ts: Contains safe utilities for currency formatting, fixed decimals, and float parsing.
frontend/src/utils/owedDriver.ts: Computes the amount owed to a driver based on meters and tips.
frontend/src/utils/pickupGuards.ts: Safely converts between timestamps, dates, and time strings for pickups.
frontend/src/utils/retryBackoff.ts: Implements retry logic with exponential backoff and jitter for async operations.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind config defining theme extensions, OKLCH-based color system, custom animations, and enabling typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project state metadata containing issue reports and existing feature requirements focused on backend connection failure handling and improved initialization diagnostics.
